observations: Photo 0 shows a bare engine block pulled from a vehicle, sitting on a dirty workshop floor, surrounded by other engines/parts in the background.
Wiring harness, intake manifold, serpentine belt, and various sensors are visible, consistent with a V-type engine.
No VIN plate, engine code sticker, or stamped part number is visible anywhere in the photo.

A watermark reading 'Victor Mazeco' and a caption 'SPARK 30C' with camera EXIF-style text (27mm f/1.6 1/100s ISO147) appear on the image; these are just photo overlays, not proof of the engine's origin or specification.
No car body, chassis, or dashboard is shown — only the engine assembly itself, despite the seller calling it a 'car'.

identity.kind: used car engine (claimed for Lexus LX, specific model unreadable)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a bare engine, no car body or VIN; also 'LX460' is not a standard Lexus LX trim (known trims are LX450, LX470, LX570, LX600), so the exact vehicle fitment cannot be confirmed from the image.

claims.claim: Japan engine (implying tokunbo/import, low mileage, good condition)
claims.evidence: No import sticker, mileage tag, or engine code plate visible in photo 0 to confirm Japanese origin or usage history.

risks.risk: Exact engine displacement/model (e.g., 1UR-FE, 3UR-FE, etc.) cannot be confirmed, which drives price heavily for Lexus LX engines.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/stamp usually found on the block near the engine mount, or a VIN/engine tag sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic V-engine, lowest comparable bracket

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (compression, timing, bearings) not visible from an external static photo.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine running/starting with audible idle sound.

risks.risk: Claimed 'Japan import' (tokunbo) status cannot be confirmed; could be a used/damaged local engine relabeled.
risks.proof: Photo of import documentation, auction sheet, or Japan export tag often attached to tokunbo engines.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified-origin used engine, not premium tokunbo

risks.risk: Visible grime, staining, and what may be fluid leakage near the bottom of the engine suggest possible oil/coolant leaks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the oil pan, valve covers, and head gasket area for leak evidence.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming leak present, needing reseal

risks.risk: Mileage is unknown and unverifiable from a photo.
risks.proof: Photo of odometer or auction sheet showing mileage at time of import.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/stamp or ID plate on the block
Video of the engine running (idle and revving) with sound
Photo of any Japan export/auction sheet or import documentation
Close-up photos of oil pan, valve cover gaskets, and hoses for leaks
Wide shot showing the full engine bay context or vehicle it was pulled from, if available
response.reason: The photo shows only a bare, unmarked engine with no readable code, tag, or VIN to confirm it is genuinely from a Lexus LX or to identify the specific engine variant that determines price, and the seller's claimed model name does not match any real Lexus LX trim.
